snippet.title: Moose Diver is out now!
snippet.description:
Get it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3738330/Moose_Diver/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campain=rel_trailer

You’re a moose on a diving adventure. Swim into the ocean and vacuum coins from the seabed. Sell the coins and earn money to upgrade and buy new gear. Swim deeper and find treasure chests to collect power boosting artefacts, but don’t forget to keep an eye on your oxygen level.
